priya rao: Heads-up — we started the v9 rollout at 09:04 and latency p50 for text-gen jumped to 420ms. Can someone confirm the emergency-stop path for the new routing flag?

alex kim: I can take ownership if it's a quick flip. Which flag exactly?

priya rao: flag name: feature.routing.v9_canary (service=inference). We need a safe disable that preserves sessions and falls back to v8.

jamie carter: Oncall runbook: toggle in console -> Feature Flags -> inference -> routing.v9_canary -> set OFF then confirm traffic back to v8. Also run the cleanup job if it was partially applied.

sam weiss: If you're on CLI, use the ops-tool command:
```
ops-tool feature toggle --service inference --flag routing.v9_canary --state off --reason "latency spike" --preserve-sessions
```
Make sure you include --preserve-sessions so user sessions aren't dropped.

ops-bot: Audit note: any manual toggle must include an audit annotation. Use `--ticket` or add a short note in the console UI.

alex kim: Quick checklist before flip: 1) PM notified, 2) rollout paused in CD, 3) observability alert muted (if noisy), 4) have a rollback message prepared.

priya rao: Who is authorized to flip this outside of oncall? We should avoid accidental flips.

jamie carter: Policy: only oncall lead (role:oncall-lead) or infra-rotation engineer + one engineering manager signoff. If both not available, page Eng-SRE and escalate.

sam weiss: Escalation path: page eng-oncall -> if no response 5m, page eng-sre -> if still no response 15m, page platform leadership. Include thread link and spike graphs.

priya rao: After flip: include one-line audit in the toggle UI and open a short incident note with timestamps (start, flip, stabilization). We need this for postmortem.

alex kim: I'll stand by to execute. Priya, can you paste the live p50/p95 graphs?

priya rao: Pasted graphs in #incidents and linked here. Paging jamie to confirm you can authorize if needed. :point_up: 

jamie carter: I see the graphs, approve flip if Alex says ready. Remember to attach ticket ID to the toggle command.

alex kim: Executing now with reason and ticket: ops-tool ... --ticket INF-4872

ops-bot: Toggle succeeded: routing.v9_canary -> OFF by alex kim at 1718554500 | reason="latency spike" | ticket=INF-4872

priya rao: Traffic back to v8, p50 down to 110ms, p95 improving. Thank you.

sam weiss: Follow-up: schedule a short RC to figure root cause. Also add a guard in the rollout config to auto-pause if p50 > 300ms for 5min.

priya rao: Agree — I'll create the RFC and link this thread. Closing the loop here. :white_check_mark:
